turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Hi! How are you doing these days?

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: My PhD viva is in three weeks. How do I prepare for being questioned for hours?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: First, reread your thesis carefully, and make a short summary of each chapter on one page.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: I've read it so many times I'm sick of it.

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: That's normal. This time, read it like an examiner. Look for weak spots, and prepare how you'd defend them.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: What kind of questions do they ask?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Often why you chose your methods, what you'd do differently, and how your work fits into the field.

turns.speaker: user
turns.text: Should I do a mock one?

turns.speaker: moshi
turns.text: Yes. Ask your supervisor or a colleague to grill you for an hour. It makes the real one feel much more familiar.
